# How to make a lyric video with AI: free kinetic type or AI footage

**Turn a song and its lyrics into a lyric video with every word on the vocal: free kinetic type in code, or lyrics over AI footage.**

**Typical cost** with `varg-music-video`: ~$2.10 per 5 s Seedance 2.5 shot at 720p (estimate). Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay. **Free, no key:** `motion-formats`, `kinetic-type-art`, `caption-styles`.

<p><a href="../../motion-formats/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_cab816145ddf.webp" alt="Motion formats play in turn: a pixel-art runner on a CRT night level, a wave rippling through a wordmark, a VHS bouncing logo and a kinetic lyric word." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`motion-formats`](../../motion-formats/README.md): The kinetic lyric video format: word punch, line karaoke, ballad drift and build-and-slam presets on the vocal. The other 3 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill motion-formats --skill kinetic-type-art --skill caption-styles --skill varg-music-video
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Make a kinetic lyric video for ./song.mp3 with the lyrics in ./lyrics.txt, 16:9 for YouTube, white type on black."*

## Requests to paste into your agent

- "Make a kinetic lyric video for ./song.mp3 with the lyrics in ./lyrics.txt, 16:9 for YouTube, white type on black."
- "Turn the chorus of my song into a 15-second vertical lyric clip for TikTok, one word at a time on the vocal."
- "Put the lyrics of ./track.wav over AI footage of a night drive, each line drawn on its sung words."

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `varg-music-video`: ~$2.10 per 5 s Seedance 2.5 shot at 720p (estimate).
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### Can I make a lyric video for free?

Yes. The kinetic type route renders locally with HyperFrames or Remotion and FFmpeg, with no key and no credits. Only AI footage behind the words costs credits.

### How are the words synced to the song?

Whisper runs on the vocal stem with the lyric sheet as its prompt, and the sheet is aligned to what it heard, so every sung word gets a start and an end time. Every word on screen is drawn from those times.

### Can an AI video model draw the lyrics?

No. Video models don't draw text reliably, so every lyric is drawn in code on top of the footage, and the video prompts end with "No text, letters or logos."

### Which song can I use?

Music you own or have licensed. The lyric formats assume your own song; for a song made from scratch, varg-music-video covers generating one first.
